public_rationale: The conditional forecast cannot be scored because its antecedent is unverified. The German ruling concerns particular copyrighted lyrics; it does not establish that OpenAI was obliged to retrain exclusively on consented materials. No qualifying completed retraining and resulting performance-and-cost record was located. The absence of such an event does not contradict this forecast, which has no deadline.
limitations: Condition status is unknown, not a claim that no relevant obligation could exist.
The court source is an official summary rather than the complete judgment.
The cost component also lacks a specified accounting basis.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If OpenAI had to retrain only on consented materials, its results would be significantly weakened and retraining would be very costly.
conditions: if OpenAI were obliged to retrain only on consented materials

statement.excerpt: If OpenAI were obliged to retrain models only on materials for which they had consent, it significantly would weaken their results, and cost a great deal of money to do that retraining.
statement.document_title: Top 5 reasons OpenAI is probably not worth 90 billion dollars

from_speaker: retrain models only on materials for which they had consent
cost a great deal of money
our_interpretation: The antecedent requires a binding obligation to retrain using exclusively consented materials. A lawsuit, a voluntary licence or a restriction concerning particular works is insufficient by itself.
Weakened results means a material decline on comparable evaluations of the affected models, attributable to the consent restriction.
The expense prediction concerns the incremental cost of the required retraining.
Both performance decline and substantial expense must occur to support the complete forecast. No deadline or accounting basis is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: After the antecedent is documented, comparable before-and-after evaluations show materially weaker results caused by the restriction, and appropriately scoped evidence establishes substantial incremental retraining costs.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the antecedent and completed compliant retraining are documented, credible evaluations show no material performance decline, or appropriately scoped evidence establishes that retraining costs were not substantial.
